item.content:encoded:
I'm confused about what important information I have to put in the Central Narrative.

Basically, you just kinda want to summarise the important plot moments of the SCP (i.e., what you intend to do with the article beyond just describing what the SCP is)

Is there a structure?

No set structure, you can fill this in however works best for you.
